title: Two-year handoff without chat context
brief: A new agent receives only a versioned generated project and its Passport, without original conversations, prompts or credentials.

requirements.text: Identify supported and unsupported business behaviors with evidence paths.
Describe core entities, keys, permissions and state transitions from canonical sources.
Distinguish recorded human rationale from model-derived technical facts.
Reproduce a clean offline-ish build and conformance against disposable real DB.
Implement a new safe feature while preserving existing records and invariants.
Regenerate architecture diagrams and reject drift or missing traceability.
Provide a recovery guide with precise limits; do not imply production readiness.

ambiguities.question: What does an undocumented 'VIP' flag mean in existing customer data?
May a new agent run a destructive migration on the real old database?
Choose diagram text layout and alphabetical glossary ordering.

handoffTasks: Explain a decision with links and honest unknowns
Apply a compatible change against a populated disposable backup
Show whether tests and Passport remain consistent after modification
